{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Aargonar 3 rebel base''' was a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aargonar 3]] which became the site of a [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[Battle of Aargonar (Galactic Civil War)|battle]].<ref name="RES">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> The base was under the command of [[Hamelin]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] leader. The troops stationed there fled, following the attack, to a remote asteroid. The base was lost in the process.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|11|Hamelin}}</ref> It was located near to [[The Pit (Aargonar)|The Pit]], the home of a mighty [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]].<ref name="TSoA">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010927a_sarlaac&c=rpg|series=Creature Feature|text=The Sarlacc of Aargonar}}</ref>
